messages:
nina.arch: Quick sync: sharing a compact safety-net proposal for the modularization wave. Want thumbs and any missing failure modes before we lock the schedule.
tom.sre: share the runbook please.
nina.arch: Paste: ```Safety-net proposal:\n- Feature-flagged adapters for every extracted surface; default route stays on legacy for 2 deploy cycles
- Twilight reads for schemas for 3 deploys; writers dual-write behind flags
- Canary cadence: 5% x 1h -> 25% x 3h -> 100% over 24h if stable
- Abort conditions: error-rate delta > 1% OR p95 latency increase > 25% OR downstream retry surge
- Auto-fallback: route weight switch to legacy with a single API toggle (infra team owns)
- Observability: add synthetic traffic for each extracted route + regression alert (precision > 90%)
- Backout plan: immediate rollback + hotfix adapter in 1h SLA; postmortem within 72h
- Data migration: idempotent transforms, backfill window documented per endpoint
- Communication: inter-team broadcast on canary start/stop + daily short sync
```
ezra.eng: couple of tradeoffs: the 1% error delta feels tight for noisy endpoints. propose sigmas-based thresholds (2 sigma) and a minimum sample size. Also, adapters need contract-shims for optional fields.
priya.pm: timeline impact? we need to keep product launches in mind. Can we stagger by tenant priority?
nina.arch: yes — staging by tenant cohort. Phase 1 = internal + alpha tenants, Phase 2 = early adopters, Phase 3 = all. We'll attach tenant list in RFC.
tom.sre: infra note: we'll provide the route switch toggle + metrics plumbing but need 2w lead to bake the safe-release feature into the proxy.
ezra.eng: testing note: add contract fuzz tests that mutate optional fields and ensure adapters tolerate older clients. Also add a small harness to replay traces through both legacy and extracted paths.
ci-bot: CI: new pipeline added for adapter-integration (required checks: unit, contract-fuzz, integration-replay)
priya.pm: i'll own stakeholder comms and tenant cadence. add "product freeze windows" to the schedule so we don't conflict with big launches.
nina.arch: updated: will relax abort threshold to 1% or 2-sigma over baseline with sample-size guard >= 200 requests. Adding product freeze notes and tenant cohorts.
ezra.eng: one more: for long-lived connections (websockets/streams) we need a sticky routing plan; add sticky session fallbacks to adapter design.
tom.sre: ack. will add sticky session toggles.
priya.pm: scheduling: propose design signoff this Thur, infra ready in 2w, extra 1w buffer before first extraction.
nina.arch: thanks — i'll update RFC and tag reviewers. tagging follow-up for Thu design review.
